title: Cohomology conjugacy for compatible residue universal homeomorphisms
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, S a scheme, A,B commutative local rings, φ:A→B a local homomorphism, and jA:Spec A→S. Let k,k′ be fields, σ:Spec k→S, and ι:Spec k′→Spec k. Suppose ρA:Spec k→Spec κA and ρB:Spec k′→Spec κB are universal homeomorphisms with ρA≫rA≫jA=σ and ρB≫Spec(κφ)=ι≫ρA. Here rA is the closed-point map and κφ the induced residue map [def-weil-residue-field]. For any Λ-module étale sheaf F on P¹_S, put F0=P¹(jA)^*F, G0 the underlying abelian sheaf of P¹(rA)^*F0, and G the underlying abelian sheaf of P¹(σ)^*F [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. For every q≥0 there are additive equivalences b1:H^q(G0)≃H^q(G) and b2:H^q(P¹(κφ)^*G0)≃H^q(P¹(ι)^*G) such that b2(P¹(κφ)^*y)=P¹(ι)^*(b1(y)) for every cohomology class y [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. No separable closedness, strict henselianity, torsion, or stalk exchange is assumed.

proof.text: Base change ρA and ρB to projective lines; their universal-homeomorphism property is stable under this base change. Their cohomology pullbacks are additive equivalences.

Use pullback_forget_modules_iso at jA, rA and σ, and the inverse-image composition isomorphisms. The equality ρA≫rA≫jA=σ yields a sheaf isomorphism e:(P¹ρA)^*G0≅G. No naturality of the chosen forgetful comparison is needed: fix e and construct the target comparison from it.

Write u=P¹ρA,v=P¹ρB,f=P¹κφ,g=P¹ι, so vf=gu. Let c1=(vf)^*≅v^*f^* expressed over the diagonal gu and c2=(gu)^*≅g^*u^*. Define e2=(c1^{-1}c2)(G0) followed by g^*e. Define b1 as pullback along u followed by H(e), and b2 as pullback along v followed by H(e2). cohomologyPullbackFunctorial rewrites both iterated pullbacks as cohomology of gu followed by H(c1) or H(c2). Naturality moves H(e) through g-pullback; H-map composition cancels c1 with its inverse. The two sides are identical, proving the equation.
